en-US.description: Upload footwear product and angle references to generate on-foot commercial try-on images.
en-US.empty.multi: Upload at least one multi-angle footwear reference first
en-US.empty.shoeImage: Upload a footwear product image first
en-US.error.noModels: No AI model is currently available
en-US.error.noSize: The current model does not provide a usable size preset
en-US.error.referenceLimit: The reference image limit for the current model has been reached
en-US.error.references: The uploaded images do not contain usable reference identifiers
en-US.label: Footwear Try-On
en-US.placeholder.extra: For example: Asian female model, outdoor street scene, natural light, clean background…
en-US.upload.bothFeetImage.help: Upload a full image with both shoes worn, so AI can reference the overall on-foot effect.
en-US.upload.modelRefImage.help: Upload a model image so AI can reference the pose and style. If omitted, AI will generate a model automatically.
en-US.upload.multi.help: Provide at least one image. More complete angles improve the generated result.
en-US.upload.shoeImage.help: A clear front or 3/4 side product image is recommended.

zh-CN.description: 上传鞋靴商品图和多角度参考图，一键生成鞋靴上脚商拍图。
zh-CN.empty.multi: 请至少上传一张多视角鞋靴参考图
zh-CN.error.noModels: 暂无可用 AI 模型
zh-CN.error.noSize: 当前模型缺少可用尺寸配置
zh-CN.error.referenceLimit: 参考图数量已达当前模型上限
zh-CN.error.references: 图片缺少可用于生成的资源标识
zh-CN.label: 鞋靴试穿
zh-CN.placeholder.extra: 例如：亚洲女性模特，户外街头场景，自然光，干净背景…
zh-CN.upload.bothFeetImage.help: 上传穿着两只鞋的整体图，AI 参考整体上脚效果。
zh-CN.upload.modelRefImage.help: 上传模特图，AI 将参考其姿势与风格；不上传则由 AI 自动生成模特。
zh-CN.upload.multi.help: 至少提供一张图片；多角度图越完整，生成效果越好。
zh-CN.upload.shoeImage.help: 建议上传正面或 3/4 侧面的单鞋清晰图，效果更佳。
